findings.finding: Ordinary capture carried persisted attempt timestamps later than its observed time after a wall-clock rollback.
findings.resolution: Common capture_projection rejects any carried attempt time after normalized observed now.

findings.finding: Deterministic finish event ID could alias accepted or terminal event ID and pass stored-projection validation, conflicting at reducer dedupe.
findings.resolution: Shared attempt validator rejects derived finish ID equal to either lifecycle ID, including prior to finish.

findings.finding: Pre-existing projection pattern validated caller-owned mutable events then copied at return; late mutation could append an identifier to returned validated data.
findings.resolution: Entire input is captured once before validation; only owned validated snapshot returned, no late copy of caller references.

findings.finding: Malformed non-ASCII stored execution token reached hmac.compare_digest and raised unclassified TypeError.
findings.resolution: Both supplied and stored token require exact canonical32lowercasehex grammar before constant-time compare; finite source rejection and no mutation.

independentCoverage: Ordinary capture wall-clock rollback/future refusal and missing-terminal-reason actual assessment fence.
Lifecycle/attempt event ID disjointness and captured-data mutation privacy refusal.
One start and competing finish CAS winner; concurrent authoritative settlement never lost or charged again.
Lost/uncertain finish write both committed/uncommitted, malformed/no acknowledgement: one write, no implicit retry/dispatch, explicit read reconciliation.

conclusions: No caller/consumer dispatch wiring is added; new worker adapter acknowledgements are not dispatch permits or proof any evaluator/provider ran.

One closed internal evaluator attempt ordinal1 is derived from existing receipt service metadata; at most start+finish, with original lifecycle facts preserved in explicit internal schemaVersion2. Legacy schemaVersion1 still accepted without attempt fields.

Start requires current ADMITTED receipt/execution owner/live lease; finish requires exact original persisted start+execution token and may follow authoritative settlement without rewriting terminal/charge.
Exact prior row/projection, source proof, inventory, profile, ACCESS and deletion fences retained in same existing receipt transaction. No extra account locator/table/index/retention is introduced.

Seven-day acceptance-based linkable deadline remains unchanged; one start/finish replay preserves refs and coarse stored fact values, conflicting writes reject. Unknown acknowledgements never cause automatic source write or provider retry.

Internal success/failure is distinct from logical settlement, including successful internal invocation with unavailable/partial logical outcome. Only NONE or generic SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE used for internal finish; no provider-specific cause claimed.
Provider family, request units and cost remain NULL. Duration bucket is supplied internal envelope metadata, not measured external vendor latency or price proof.

Existing selective retirement/account deletion/paid authorization closure accepts new closed projection shape locally. Physical timely erasure/backups/deployed mixed versions remain separate unqualified activation gates.
Dependency checker now requires attempt protocol in authority carriers; actual rebuilt archive/final handoff review remains separate.
limits: Local source/Moto and injected synthetic write races only; no AWS, endpoint, auth, device, runtime, purchase, deployment or Git publication by reviewer.
TrustedWorkerContext/execution proof is an internal owner fence, not public network authentication or independent proof a recorded internal attempt was dispatched.
Client-side time guards cannot impose a Dynamo server wall clock; delayed commits can complete after cutoff, but no expired fact is returned and actual timely physical erasure remains unqualified.

Future consumer wiring must handle durable predispatch acknowledgement/unknown states without duplicate dispatch, preserve business outcomes if optional reporting fails, and bound added latency/cost. This is a remaining source/acceptance gate, not merely deployment.
Provider/internal subattempt completeness, authoritative actual duration/units/rate catalogue, full cost accounting, assembled discovery/revision/delivery and real Dev acceptance remain open.
Full frozen suite and rebuilt package/manifest/owner-facing docs require final handoff review; this source PASS is not SEC237 Done or activation readiness.
